note: The essay staircases from Michael's 28-page newspaper portfolio (Be2FIRST Writing Portfolio, pages 2-4), curated for 14-15-year-olds: his bold phrase first, then four more; plain labels; C1-only items left in the PDF and the Phrase Bank. 'pre' groups set the opening words of a step (Nowadays, / Firstly, / All in all,). 'start' marks a step that begins a new sentence. ' + ' splits a frame from what must follow it. Transcribed from screenshots: groups cut off at the bottom of the screen are missing and marked in 'missing'.
missing: Introduction · Opening: the end of 'a closer look' (paradox)
Body · Phrase bank: the rest of 'Causes · Effects'
Conclusion · Summing up: the rest of 'Concede first'
